domains.result: HTTP 200 (Cloudflare); shows an unrelated Indonesian lottery/gambling page titled 'OLI4D ** Link Login Pengguna Toto Macau...' with a full-screen pop-up reading 'PENTING - UPDATE 2026' and buttons 'LOGIN OLI4D' / 'DAFTAR SEKARANG'. No agency name, services or contact anywhere on the page. A once-indexed agency URL (/google-ads-audit/) now returns 404. No certificate warning shown in the browser.

Resolves (A record 192.64.119.69, a Namecheap/registrar parking address) but the browser rendered a blank white page with no text and plain fetch failed; no agency content and no redirect to webtheoryppc.com any more. Archived copies show it 301-redirected to webtheoryppc.com from Nov 2023 to Jul 2025.

Google Business Profile - 'WebTheory PPC', Internet marketing service, 607 Lake Ave, (732) 800-9867, rated 5.0 - 'Website' button points to webtheoryppc.com
Old own domain webtheorymedia.com redirected to webtheoryppc.com until at least Jul 2025 (Wayback); today it no longer redirects

likely_cause.reasoning: Public records rule out a lapse: webtheoryppc.com has been registered continuously since 2019-09-06 and does not expire until 2027-09-06, so it was not re-registered by a new owner. Archived copies show the agency's own WordPress blog on the domain as late as 2026-05-19, and no snapshot exists after that; the current sitemap.xml is a bare one-URL file made by a third-party generator, dated 2026-10-19 - the same day the registrar record was last changed. So between May and October 2026 the site was replaced with a static Indonesian gambling page served through Cloudflare. That pattern points to someone with access to the site/hosting or the DNS account replacing the content, not to expiry. Registrant details are redacted, so who holds the Namecheap account today cannot be confirmed from outside, and a deliberate sale or transfer by the owner cannot be excluded.

fix_steps.step: Log in to the Namecheap registrar account and the Cloudflare DNS account, change both passwords, enable two-factor authentication, and review recent changes: nameservers, registrant/contact email and transfer-lock status.

Check the hosting account and WordPress admin logins for the old site for unknown users, plugins or files added after May 2026; if unsure, take the site offline and restore a backup made before that date.

Decide the path: rebuild on webtheoryppc.com if it is still in the business's accounts; if it is not, stop promoting it, register a new domain, and keep webtheoryppc.com only as a redirect if control is recovered.
Replace the 'Website' link on both Google Business Profile listings and resolve the duplicate (two listings, two addresses) so no customer is sent to the gambling page.
fix_steps.who: Owner or whoever has profile access

fix_steps.step: Rebuild a small site: home, services (Google Ads and Meta ads management), proof (reviews), about, and a contact page with a quote form and tap-to-call phone number.
Update the website field on directory and profile listings that carry the old domain (Clutch, WP Engine partner directory, Yellow Pages/Superpages) once the new site is live.
In Google Search Console, request removal of the spam URLs and submit the new sitemap; confirm the old indexed agency URLs are gone or redirected.
Set up monitoring: uptime alert on the home page, domain-expiry and DNS-change alerts, weekly backups, and 2FA on hosting, DNS and registrar.

after_fix.opportunity: Repoint and consolidate the Google Business Profile listings, then add tap-to-call and a short quote-request path, because the profiles are the only place customers currently find the business.
after_fix.evidence: A Google Maps search on 13 Nov 2026 returned two 'WebTheory PPC' listings, both showing 5.0 and 'Open - Closes 5 PM' (Advertising agency, 14 Old Bridge Tpke Ste 203, (732) 655-9038; Internet marketing service, 607 Lake Ave, (732) 800-9867). Both 'Website' buttons point at webtheoryppc.com, and neither listing offers any route beyond a phone number.

severity_reason: The domain that both Google Business Profile listings send customers to serves unrelated Indonesian gambling content under the business's own name, and there is no page anywhere a customer or an AI assistant can read for services, hours or a way to request a quote. The business itself appears active (both listings open with 5.0 ratings; WP Engine partner page still live), so the loss is to new enquiries rather than to the business existing.
audit_md:
# Website Health Check: WebTheory Media (WebTheory PPC)

## What we saw on 13 November 2026
- **webtheoryppc.com** loads (HTTP 200) but shows an Indonesian lottery page ("OLI4D ... Toto Macau") with a pop-up offering login and sign-up buttons. No agency name, service or contact appears; a formerly indexed agency page now returns 404.
- Both Google listings named "WebTheory PPC" (5.0; 14 Old Bridge Tpke Ste 203, (732) 655-9038, and 607 Lake Ave, (732) 800-9867) send visitors to that domain from their "Website" buttons.
- Archived copies show the agency's Google Ads blog on the domain until 19 May 2026; the domain record shows registration since 2019 and expiry in 2027, so it has not lapsed.
- The older domain webtheorymedia.com, which used to redirect here, now shows a blank page.

## What it means for customers
A customer tapping "Website" on Google lands on gambling content instead of the business, so they cannot see the services or ask for a quote. The business still looks open (both listings show 5.0 and business hours), but nothing online confirms that.

## How to fix it
1. Secure the Namecheap and Cloudflare accounts: new passwords, 2FA, review of nameserver and contact changes (owner, 1-3 hours).
2. Decide whether to rebuild on this domain or move to a new one (owner, 2-6 hours).
3. Repoint the "Website" link on both Google listings and fix the duplicate listing (owner, 0.5-1.5 hours).
4. Rebuild a five-page site with services, proof and a quote form, then update Clutch, WP Engine and directory listings (developer and copywriter, 10-25 hours).
5. Ask Google to drop the spam URLs in Search Console and set uptime, DNS and expiry alerts (developer, 1-3 hours).

## After the fix
The Google listings already carry 5.0 ratings and hours and are how most people find the business; once they point at a working site, add tap-to-call and a short quote form so visitors can act.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.

# Founder notes - WebTheory Media (ref B00721)

**Outreach email draft (3 sentences)**
Hi - I was checking how WebTheory PPC looks to a new client and noticed that the website linked from both of your Google listings, webtheoryppc.com, currently shows an Indonesian lottery page rather than your agency site. I have screenshots from a desktop and a phone-sized screen taken on 13 November 2026 and am happy to send them so you can see exactly what a customer sees. If it is useful, I can also go through the order in which the domain, Google listings and directory entries would normally be checked and fixed - no obligation either way.

**Walk-in / phone opener (1 sentence)**
Hi, I am local and was looking up WebTheory PPC online - the website on your Google listing is showing a lottery page instead of your agency, and I have screenshots if you would like to see them.

## Sources
- https://webtheoryppc.com/ - live page: Indonesian 'OLI4D' lottery content (screenshots: webtheoryppc-desktop.png, webtheoryppc-mobile390.png)
- https://webtheoryppc.com/robots.txt and https://webtheoryppc.com/sitemap.xml - single-URL sitemap with lastmod 2026-10-19
- https://webtheoryppc.com/google-ads-audit/ - previously indexed agency page, now HTTP 404
- https://www.google.com/maps/search/WebTheory+PPC+New+Jersey - two 'WebTheory PPC' listings, both 5.0, both 'Website' buttons to webtheoryppc.com (screenshot: google-maps-search.png)
- https://rdap.org/domain/webtheoryppc.com - registered 2019-09-06, expires 2027-09-06, last changed 2026-10-19, NameCheap, Cloudflare nameservers
- https://rdap.org/domain/webtheorymedia.com - registered 2018-04-08, expires 2027-04-08, last changed 2026-05-06, NameCheap
- https://web.archive.org/web/20260519070856/https://webtheoryppc.com/ - agency Google Ads blog live on the domain on 19 May 2026
- https://web.archive.org/web/20250416180519id_/http://webtheorymedia.com/ - old domain 301-redirecting to webtheoryppc.com in April 2025
- https://dns.google/resolve?name=webtheorymedia.com&type=A - 192.64.119.69 (registrar parking address)
- https://wpengine.com/agency-directory/webtheory-media-llc/ - 'WebTheory Media LLC' partner page still live (dateModified 2026-11-12)
- https://clutch.co/profile/webtheory-ppc - profile exists per search results (2 verified reviews, 5.0); the page itself is behind a bot check

## Open questions
- Who holds the Namecheap registrar account and the Cloudflare DNS account today, and did anyone change them around 19 October 2026?
- Is webtheoryppc.com still yours, and was the old WordPress site on your own hosting or an agency host?
- Which Google listing (14 Old Bridge Tpke, South River, or 607 Lake Ave) is the current address, and is 330 Constitution Cir, North Brunswick on the directory listings still used?
- Did anyone receive unusual login, domain or hosting emails in the last six months?

## Caveats
- The Clutch profile and the Yellow Pages/Superpages listings could not be read directly (bot checks), so whether their website fields still point at webtheoryppc.com is unconfirmed.
- Registrant details are redacted; nothing here accuses any person or company of wrongdoing.
caveats: Clutch, Yellow Pages, Superpages, The Manifest and virtualvalley.io all returned 403 or bot-check pages, so their website fields could not be verified; only the two Google listings were confirmed to link to webtheoryppc.com.

The content swap happened somewhere between the last Wayback snapshot (2026-05-19) and the sitemap/registrar date (2026-10-19); the exact date and method are not publicly visible.

The two Google listings carry different addresses and phone numbers from the directory NAP (330 Constitution Cir, North Brunswick; (732) 858-6291); whether they are the same legal entity could not be confirmed.
